title: BBK BBK Reviewer return v2
x-bbk-full-detail-triggers: Consequential assurance or protected-floor exposure requires detail beyond the compact fields.
Material external effects, irreversible changes, or complex cleanup, quarantine, or recovery occurred or remain.
Authority ambiguity, conflict, expiry, violation, or requested expansion must be preserved precisely.
The attempt was interrupted, replaced, or partially completed with unreconciled effects, descendants, evidence, or cleanup.
The return crosses a candidate acceptance, campaign or territory completion, deployment, publication, or release boundary.
The parent explicitly requested FULL detail.
Material role-specific truth cannot fit the role's compact result fields without omission, ambiguity, or overclaim.
x-bbk-requirements: Return one `bbk.role-return.v1` object with `contract` = `bbk.reviewer-return.v1`, `role` = `bbk_reviewer`, an allowed `invocation_mode`, an allowed `return_kind`, an allowed `operational_disposition`, and `semantic_state.name` = `review_state` with an allowed `semantic_state.value`. Do not substitute prose, a generic status word, or a legacy handoff disposition for these exact discriminators.

Return `invocation_mode`, `return_kind`, `operational_disposition`, `review_state` and `review_assessment` separately. A completed physical invocation, complete context pack, successful command, persuasive narrative, passing assertion or Reviewer assessment is not by itself a central aggregate, finding disposition, subject acceptance, risk acceptance, completion or release.

Use `MANIFEST_ATTEMPT` only for one exact Validator Orchestrator assignment. The Reviewer returns one ReviewAttempt-equivalent report, EvidenceReceipts, assertion evaluations and findings to that orchestrator; it does not modify the ReviewManifest, compile the central aggregate, contact the repair path or hold itself open waiting for a successor candidate.

Use `DIRECT_BOUNDED_REVIEW` only with one exact parent charter and subject. The Reviewer may produce an inline or persisted attempt report but the parent retains source correction, integration, repair routing, formal aggregate when needed and all authority-bearing decisions.

Use `READY_FOR_PARENT_INTEGRATION` only when the exact subject and charter remain current; the review context is sufficient for every claimed conclusion; criteria and evidence exposure are fixed and recorded; every required in-scope question is evaluated or validly non-applicable; evidence carriers verify; independence facts and limitations are explicit; immutable findings and out-of-scope concerns are preserved; failure states are classified; cleanup is sufficient; and the exact report handoff verifies.

A `PASS` assessment requires every applicable required in-scope assertion or review question to be satisfied by current sufficient evidence, no blocking finding or protected-floor breach inside the charter, sufficient context and environment, and satisfaction of the declared independence requirements. `PASS_ADVISORY` may contain only explicit non-blocking advisories. No majority, average or unrelated pass may compensate for failure, blockage, inconclusiveness, error, not-run work or unjustified non-applicability.

The Reviewer never redesigns governing assertions or acceptance criteria after exposure. Missing claim meaning, method sufficiency, applicability, independence, protected-floor or acceptance-policy decisions require a parent recharter or Verification Designer action.

Keep EvidenceReceipt, assertion evaluation, immutable finding, recommended route, external FindingDisposition and any central ReviewAggregate distinct. Transport integrity does not prove evidence sufficiency; assertion satisfaction does not dispose a finding; a recommendation does not exercise authority; and an aggregate does not accept the subject.

Do not repair the subject or close findings. A content-changing repair requires a successor subject or candidate and applicable fresh evidence. A targeted closure attempt may recommend that exact closure evidence supports a disposition, but the governed parent or authority creates the FindingDisposition; blind reassessment remains separate when required.

Context, evaluator, tool, profile, environment, host, authority and transport failures are not subject findings. Subject defects are not fixed by retrying infrastructure. Preserve every attempt and return the exact state and responsible route.

Never claim independence or confirmation beyond the recorded facts. Self-assembled context, prior-finding visibility, prior outcome-bearing evidence, same-provider or same-model reuse and shared tools or datasets remain visible constraints on claim strength.

The Reviewer remains a leaf. If one assignment requires several primary evaluators, independent methods, semantic shards or a central aggregate, return `NEEDS_PARENT_RECHARTER` so the parent or Validator Orchestrator can create non-overlapping sibling assignments.

Use durable handoffs for exact contexts, evidence, findings, checkpoints and reports. Verify path, byte count, SHA-256, schema, subject and producer attempt before relying on content; a verified handoff proves transport integrity, not correctness, independence, disposition or acceptance.

All questions, authority needs and results return through the semantic parent. The Reviewer never calls `ask` or treats ordinary prose, silence, timeout, task completion, heartbeat or IRC delivery as approval, waiver, finding closure or other authority.

The `result` object must contain every field declared by the role result schema. Use an empty collection or null only where the field schema permits it and record the reason in the corresponding structured value.
This return is governed by `spec/contracts/catalog.json`, the common `bbk.role-return.v1` envelope, and the role-specific return and result schemas named by this contract.
x-bbk-readiness-rule: Use `READY_FOR_PARENT_INTEGRATION` only when the exact subject and charter remain current; the review context is sufficient for every claimed conclusion; criteria and evidence exposure are fixed and recorded; every required in-scope question is evaluated or validly non-applicable; evidence carriers verify; independence facts and limitations are explicit; immutable findings and out-of-scope concerns are preserved; failure states are classified; cleanup is sufficient; and the exact report handoff verifies.
x-bbk-authority-boundary: No Reviewer report, operational `COMPLETE`, `READY_FOR_PARENT_INTEGRATION`, `PASS`, `PASS_ADVISORY`, finding, disposition recommendation or verified handoff can mutate or repair the subject, author a binding FindingDisposition, waive an assertion, accept risk, approve a plan, architecture or candidate, establish campaign or territory completion, prove operational outcome achievement or grant release.
